jobs: Notice a target: upper neck stiffens, head holds standard height, foreclaws curl in readiness. Tail coil tightens slightly. Mouth still closed.
Early windup: pull the head about40px backward-left, upper neck curve tightens, cyan mane lifts, near foreclaw starts drawing up toward chest. Far foreclaw remains relaxed.
Windup increases: head pulled about80px backward-left, jaws start opening to reveal a few fangs, near foreground foreclaw raised ahead of chest with bent elbow. Lower coil stays compact.
Deep windup: head about100px behind standard, near foreground foreclaw lifted toward the front of pale chest, far foreclaw stays lower. Upper S neck tightly curved, jaw open. Hindlegs flex inward.
Last windup: same pulled-back head and tight neck curve, open jaw, raised near foreclaw poised to reach forward. Cyan mane swept upward; tail stabilizes body. No extra hands.
Lunge begins: upper neck uncoils forward-right, head approaches standard position, near foreclaw drives forward with bent elbow. Mouth open, whiskers stream back to stay compact.

Forward strike building: head about70px right of standard, upper neck partly straightens, near foreclaw reaches forward-right toward x1010,y680. Far foreclaw held beneath upper torso, hindlegs tucked. Do not lengthen bones.

Strong forward strike: head about100px right of standard, jaws wide but same head size. Foreground near foreclaw reaches x1060,y650, fingers spread. Whiskers trail backward, not beyond canvas. Tail coil counterbalances.

Peak bite-and-claw strike: head forward-right about110px, near foreclaw reaches x1080,y660, jaw open with readable fangs. Far foreclaw and two hindlegs tucked at their original roots. Upper neck extended through curve change, not anatomical stretch.
Downward follow-through: forward head lowers a little, near striking claw arcs down to x1040,y735, mouth still partly open. Lower coil and tail stable, mane and whiskers lag behind.
Start recovery: neck recoils halfway toward center, head only about60px forward of standard, striking near claw pulls back toward x920,y730. Far foreclaw remains attached and relaxed.
Recovery continuing: head about30px forward of standard, jaws begin closing, near foreclaw elbow bends toward chest. Upper S curve reforms, whiskers settle.
Late recovery: head returns to standard position and height, mouth nearly closed, foreclaws lower halfway to standard. Mane fins settle and tail coil loosens.
End recoil: standard head position, closed mouth, upper neck and middle S curves near original. Near foreclaw relaxes, far foreclaw returns to its standard position.
Nearly recovered standard hovering S silhouette: original head height, original body curves, three obvious limbs plus partly hidden fourth, relaxed claws. Only minor whisker and mane settling.

Final recovery at EXACT original idle_0 silhouette: original head, antlers, neck, body coils and claw positions, mouth closed, standard long whisker curls, lower tail plume at original angle. No raised striking arm, no stretched neck.
